buildDir.description: Path to the build's Mids dump directory.

midsDir.description: Path to the shared dump directory; defaults to the build directory's grandparent.

midsDb.description: Path to the directory holding AttribMod.json, which prices pets; omit to leave pets out.

options.description: The planning options: stance, form, target, move and standoff; omit any for its default.

stance.description: The stance to plan: melee, ranged, hybrid or all.

form.description: The form to plan for; omit for the build's own.

target.description: The scenario: single, or spawn:N for a spawn of N.

move.description: How the character moves between attacks: run, jump or fly.

standoff.description: The ranged standoff in feet; omit for the default.
